$meta.ruling: 裁决九.4 — 退役口径固化 (monolith retirement discipline, fixated).
$meta.purpose: Authoritative inventory of vec_dot MONOLITH block-dot op-defs that still exist in ODS (include/Weft/Dialect/RVV/IR/RVVOps.td). DELIBERATELY RETAINED entries require a non-overlapping declared role and evidence. PENDING RETIREMENT entries are named RET-1 violation/debt, not compliant compatibility exceptions: typed construction has superseded their slice but residual op-def/emitter/verifier refs remain. Naming a batch prevents an anonymous dead tail; it does not authorize completion, new callers, wider predicates, or indefinite survival. The machine gate tools/gates/check_monolith_retire.py fails closed on any unregistered survivor or stale entry.
constitution: A 'vec_dot monolith' = an ODS op-def whose description says 'Records the COMPLETE ggml `ggml_vec_dot_<fmt>_<act>` (super-)block dot-product as ONE ...' — the WHOLE ggml vec_dot recorded as ONE opaque op. Bricks/cores ('Records the INTEGER CORE ...' / 'Records the WHOLE per-super-block body ...') and the GEMM/GEMV/REPACK/PACK family are NOT monoliths and are out of scope.

deliberately_retained = a monolith currently retained under RET-1 because it has a declared non-overlapping execution role or an isolated negative-control role, plus owner and evidence. It is not a permanent shape-based exemption: if predicates overlap, the role disappears, or a negative control becomes production-reachable, it must be reclassified and converged.

pending_retirement = PRE-RET-1 VIOLATION/DEBT: the front door already SUPERSEDED the slice with a typed body, but an op-def/emitter/verifier/name ref still lingers. A batch pointer, owner, caller set and deletion condition are mandatory. Registration does NOT make the state compliant and MUST NOT gain new callers or a wider predicate.

The gate is fail-closed in BOTH directions: an ODS monolith absent from this list => RED (unnamed dead tail); a list entry whose op-def no longer exists in ODS => RED (stale whitelist — a retired op must be MOVED to retired_ledger, keeping the live list == the exact surviving set).
Retired verifiers are PLAIN-DELETED from the .cpp (git history is the archive). An `#if 0 ... GgmlBlockDot*::verify ... #endif` tomb left in a dialect/conversion .cpp is itself a residual and is RED.
